literal_meaning: এই পিঠ - ওই পিঠ (this side - that side)
figurative_meaning_en: up and down; both sides; two sides
similar_in_english: two sides of the same coin
example_sentences_in_english: Both sides of the village are equally good.
One must see both sides of life.
note: Often used in rural contexts to denote equivalence or duality in simple, everyday matters.
